**Finding submitted: missing (fallback cure inserted).**

- **Investigation:** Section 8 contains only Client warranties; Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES") is limited to Year 2000 readiness; Sections 3–4 give only "reasonable commercial efforts" response-time/availability undertakings; p0042 and p0041 expressly disclaim data accuracy; p0076 is a general disclaimer.
- **Gap:** No conformance-to-documentation warranty, no professional-and-workmanlike standard, no repair/replace/refund remedy — the fallback fails on every element. Not walk-away, since the disclaimer is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so an inserted express warranty survives and no carve-out edit was needed.
- **Cure:** One short insert after p0060 at the fallback level — 90-day software conformance, 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement, re-performance or refund of fees paid. No survival tail, compliance-with-laws, malicious-code or other non-element extras added.
